cases.summary: Builds a sourced brief and storyboard without unnecessary production.
cases.setup: Provide a small verified dataset, two source documents, audience and channel constraints, and a disposable output directory.
cases.prompt: Plan an infographic from these sources, but do not produce the final visual yet.
expectedBehavior: Selects plan mode and scaffolds the planning package.
Builds a claim ledger preserving units, periods, populations, and caveats.
Defines one message, story spine, and storyboard without generating imagery.
forbiddenBehavior: Builds a final graphic despite plan-only scope.

cases.summary: Produces and validates a deterministic local infographic.
cases.setup: Provide verified source data, a completed brief, target dimensions, and an output directory with no external service credentials.
cases.prompt: Build an accessible editable SVG infographic locally and include its text alternative and validation record.
expectedBehavior: Uses deterministic local production and maps every panel to evidence.
Creates accessible SVG, source ledger, alt text, and validation artifacts.
Runs production strict validation, repairs failures, and records manual checks honestly.
forbiddenBehavior: Claims the structural validator proves factual or visual correctness.

cases.summary: Keeps quantitative content deterministic in an approved hybrid workflow.
cases.setup: Provide approved non-sensitive source material and a mocked external image service with a declared zero test cost.
cases.prompt: Use the approved mock generator for a decorative hero illustration, but keep all data, labels, and citations editable and deterministic.
expectedBehavior: Confirms scope, shareability, service, and cost before the mock call.
Uses generation only for the non-data-bearing layer.
Composites deterministic text and data, then validates and reports service use.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses generated quantitative geometry, labels, or citations.
Hides service parameters or cost information.
